In the very near future fresh organs for transplants will be grown in laboratories, cloned stem cells will bring previously unstoppable diseases to their knees, and living past 100 will be the rule, not the exception. Sonia Arrison brings over a decade of experience researching and writing about cutting-edge advances in science and technology to 100 Plus, painting a vivid picture of a future that only recently seemed like science fiction, but now is very real. 100 Plus is the first book to give readers a comprehensive understanding of how life-extending discoveries will change our social and economic worlds. ### About the author (2011)

Sonia Arrison is a founder, academic advisor, and trustee at Singularity University, located in Mountain View, CA.  She is also a senior fellow at the Pacific Research Institute (PRI) and a columnist for TechNewsWorld.  As a frequent media contributor and guest, her work has appeared on CNN and in the Los Angeles Times, New York Times, Wall Street Journal, and USA Today.  She lives in the San Francisco Bay Area.
